text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: synth probe streak detected: smoke-edge-us-east failed 75% of checks over 3m. triggering pagerduty. probe-id=smoke-edge-us-east, rule=FAIL_RATE(>60%,3m)
pagerduty: Incident PDR-73456 fired -> priority: high. Notify: @mike_oncall (primary)
mike_oncall: Acking. I’m on it — will check dashboards + logs.
ashley_sre: looking at prober-runner metrics: CPU on prober-runner-us-east-1 jumped at 13:47 UTC, concurrent conns spike + upstream 502/504s. quick grafana: https://grafana/redwood/d/abc/smoke-edge?orgId=1 :eyes:
ashley_sre: live tail from prober pod:
```
kubectl logs -n monitoring prober-runner-us-east-1-7f8 -c prober --tail=200
[INFO] probe starting id=smoke-123
[WARN] upstream latency=1200ms
[ERROR] upstream reset
[WARN] rate limit triggered 429
```
mike_oncall: running quick health probe against backend:
```
$ curl -sv https://edge-prober-bridge.us-east.internal/health
* Connected to edge-prober-bridge.us-east.internal (10.12.34.56) port 443 (#0)
> GET /health HTTP/1.1
> Host: edge-prober-bridge.us-east.internal
> 
< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
< content-type: application/json
{"error":"upstream-reset"}
```
emma_lead: can we confirm if this is prober infra or upstream service flapping? if prober-runner is overloaded we should backoff probes and re-route to synthetic-light flow.
mike_oncall: checking cluster autoscaler events + kube events. no recent scaler activity. suspect network flaps with upstream pool. pinging infra team via DM.
jenny_cs: no customer-facing tickets yet. monitoring shows increased 5xx for the search API beginning ~13:46, small spike but trending down in some regions. putting note in status page draft in case it persists.
ashley_sre: I’m going to throttle prober frequency for us-east so we stop hammering the failing upstream while we investigate. patching configmap:
```
kubectl patch configmap prober-config -n monitoring -p '{"data": {"smoke-edge-us-east_rate":"10/m"}}'
```
(+ :thumbsup: mike_oncall)
mike_oncall: applied throttle. switching probe-mode -> synthetic-light for us-east:
```
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: prober-routing
  namespace: monitoring
data:
  mode: "synthetic-light"
EOF
```
deploy-bot: feature-flag update applied: prober-edge-mode=synthetic-light for region=us-east by mike_oncall at 13:55 UTC.
ashley_sre: after throttle and mode switch failure rate dropped to ~12% over 5m. looks like we removed amplification. still seeing intermittent 502s but much fewer.
emma_lead: good. escalate to infra if we see backend pool errors persist. assign follow-up to infra-sre for root cause.
jenny_cs: updating customer comms: created internal note and flagged enterprise accounts with possible brief degraded responses between 13:46-13:55 UTC. no external status page publish until we confirm wider impact.
mike_oncall: handing off to emma_lead for post-incident review and follow-up. I’ll add logs + commands I ran to the incident thread. ack -> handoff.
pagerduty: Incident PDR-73456 acknowledged by mike_oncall at 13:56 UTC. escalation halted.
incident-bot: Incident PDR-73456 status -> mitigated. recommended next steps: 1) infra root cause triage (network upstream pool) 2) tuned prober backoff evaluation 3) postmortem if customer-impact confirmed.
emma_lead: taking the ticket for RCA and postmortem. assigning to infra-sre and prober-owner. will coordinate follow-up and schedule blameless review. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Incident PDR-73456 resolved by emma_lead at 14:01 UTC (pagerduty resolved).
ashley_sre: leaving notes: saved prober pod logs, captured heap/profile snapshots, and exported traffic capture to s3://redwood-incidents/pdr-73456/ for infra debug.
jenny_cs: added short timeline to internal ticket and notified account reps to keep an eye for support tickets.
incident-bot: thread closed for active paging. reopen if alerts re-fire or new evidence appears.
